controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-06T09:59:11.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T09:59:11.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-2"
        AND source.ip == "172.18.0.16"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS events = COUNT(*) BY event.outcome, auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey", message LIKE "*password*", "password", "other")
| SORT events DESC
